terms.gloss: a valuer, appraiser; one who weighs things up
evidence: Cic. Par. 6.3: callidī rērum aestimātōrēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Classically one who sets a value on things, frūmentī (Cic. Pis. 35), and figuratively a judge of their worth, jūstus rērum aestimātor (Cic. Or. 41) (Lewis & Short). Stretched to an analyst, it is our use.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. appraiser.
